explanations.authorised-1230044: The inside expands more rapidly than the outside is correct. The inner surface expands faster than the outer, causing stress and cracking. explanations.authorised-1230045: 1104J is correct. Q = mcΔT = 0.06 × 460 × 40 = 1104 J. Use Q = mcΔT because the iron changes temperature without a phase change. explanations.authorised-1230046: 46.71mmHg is correct. P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂ → P₂ = 40 × 348/298 ≈ 46.71 mmHg. At constant volume, pressure is directly proportional to absolute temperature, so P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂. The temperature must be used in kelvin because the gas-law proportionality is based on absolute temperature.
explanations.authorised-1230047: Newton is correct. Newton is a derived unit (kg·m/s²); others are base SI units. The deciding feature here is the measurements and units relationship described in the question.

explanations.authorised-1230135: I and III is correct. Radio waves and gamma rays are electromagnetic; sound and water are mechanical. The deciding feature here is the magnets and magnetic fields relationship described in the question.
explanations.authorised-1230137: 200 Ω is correct. X_L = 2πfL = 2π × (50/π) × 2 = 200 Ω. The deciding feature here is the current electricity relationship described in the question.
